The language is not clear from this text. Pick it in the Translate tool and try again.
Data saver is on. Tap the action again to send this over mobile data.
This app does not take changes to this text. Copy the result instead.

Select text in any app, and the menu that offers Copy and Paste can offer the keyboard\'s actions too. You do not have to be typing with this keyboard, or copy the text anywhere first.\n\nEach switch here is one entry in every app\'s menu, so turn on the ones you use.
WM Keyboard in the selection menu
Translate, AI and these actions on text selected in any app

Opens a sheet over the app with the text you selected. Translate it, run an AI action on it, or rewrite it with the actions from the list below (case, lines, the converters), one after another. Undo steps back.

When the text is in a box you can edit, Replace puts the result in place of your selection. When it is not, such as a web page, Copy takes it instead.

This works whether the keyboard's own bar is on or off.
Save as note on the sheet
WM Translate in the selection menu
An entry that opens straight on the translation. Needs the Translate tool
